script = '''
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import openpyxl

# OCR the invoice image
img = Image.open("uploads/invoice.png")
text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

print("=== OCR TEXT ===")
print(text)
print("=== END ===")

# Create Excel workbook
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice OCR"

# Write each line of OCR text into a separate row
lines = text.split("\\n")
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=line)

# Auto-adjust column width
max_len = max((len(line) for line in lines), default=10)
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = min(max_len + 2, 100)

wb.save("invoice_ocr.xlsx")
print("\\nSaved to invoice_ocr.xlsx")
'''
await write_file("./ocr_script.py", script)
print("Script written.")

ocr_result = await run_command("python ./ocr_script.py")
print(ocr_result)

info = await get_file_info("./invoice_ocr.xlsx")
print(info)
